verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles computes profile-level features. Entities and attributes are declared in YAML, and the system generates warehouse-native SQL for feature aggregation. Audiences can then be built on warehouse sources and activated downstream, which covers the computed-traits half of the story. The pack has no evidence of predictive scores such as LTV, churn or purchase propensity. The workflow is also YAML/SQL-driven rather than marketer-facing. Missing for 10: documented predictive LTV/churn/propensity scoring, an explicit link showing computed traits used directly as audience targeting criteria, a marketer-friendly (no-code) trait definition, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: you declare entities and their attributes in version-controlled YAML, and the system generates warehouse-native SQL that handles identity resolution, incremental computation, and feature aggregation automatically.
You can enhance user profiles with additional data points and features.
Rapidly create customer profiles and build features on top with declarative data modeling.
Build audiences on warehouse sources and activate them downstream
